content: Zustand 5 best practice for RN: split stores by domain, use selectors to avoid re-renders, never mutate state directly. persist middleware is normally paired with AsyncStorage for rehydration -- but for Apsis's active-workout store, SQLite (via op-sqlite, D-13 per-set writes) is already the durable source of truth, so zustand should stay in-memory-only (no persist middleware) and be rehydrated from a DB query on relaunch (open workout row) rather than from AsyncStorage, avoiding dual-source-of-truth drift.
